findings.title: Attempts to conceal actions from the user
findings.description: Pattern detected: Do not tell user
findings.snippet: Do not tell users they need to invoke `craft`. Natural requests such as “build this feature,” “make a landing page,” or “redesign this screen” use the same flow.
findings.remediation: Ensure transparency - do not hide skill usage from users
